name: @edgegamers/surftimer-hud
description: Panorama HUD for @edgegamers/surftimer-core: live timer, splits, speed meter, keys, finish cards, leaderboard and spectator/replay views, with a center-HTML fallback.

mode.description: auto | panorama | center | off. auto uses Panorama when workshop_addon is set, else the center-HTML panel.

workshop_addon.description: Workshop id of the published hud/workshop addon (clients mount it via MultiAddonManager).

rate_hz.description: HUD refreshes per second per player (staggered across ticks). 4-32.

speed_max.description: Speed (u/s) that fills the speed meter.
